text_summary.body: While Daniel is still praying, Gabriel comes in swift flight about the time of the evening offering, says that a word went out at the beginning of Daniel's supplications because he is greatly loved, and gives him the word of the seventy weeks (recorded separately as a prophecy).

setting.body: The "evening offering" names a time of day in a period when, on the text's setting, the Temple lay in ruins; Jerome takes it to show that Daniel prayed from the morning to the evening sacrifice.

constraints.subject: evt_01M4V10B5RW2WTTJ28DXRPQSWD
constraints.textual_assertion: While I was speaking … about the time of the evening offering

terminology.gloss: The afternoon/evening grain offering, used here as a time marker.

commentary.paraphrase: Guzik notes that the answer was sent at the beginning of the prayer and that Gabriel came at the hour of the evening sacrifice.

not_applicable.competing_reconstructions: No competing reconstructions of the encounter itself; interpretations of the prophecy are on the prophecy record.
